positive_snippets: Had the best experience hosting my mom’s birthday at Goa Country Club! The staff was genuinely kind and attentive, the kind that smiles at you even when you’re running around last minute. Everything was smooth and effortless on their end. The service was on point, the venue looked amazing, and the food was loved by literally every guest (which is rare). Super grateful for how well everything was handled. Would 100% recommend for anyone looking to host a chill, well-managed event. ✨
negative_snippets:
If you have extra money to waste, only then consider choosing this place. They charge you for the smallest things even for taking a few extra steps on their property. The management and planning are extremely poor, and no one seems to know what’s happening within their own resort.

I booked this property for my wedding reception, and the experience was truly disappointing. Throughout the function, they kept approaching us with additional bills for services that were already included. It felt very unprofessional and money-minded.

They even went back on their words and charged us for things as minor as a light bulb being used in the manager’s office.

Overall, I would not recommend this place at all.
